merge_policy: Union = the 12 graded inputs, the race's own unit, so no phrasing merges were needed. caught_by per item = scorers the grader majority (>=3 of 4 graders with a matrix: T654, T655, T657, T658) ruled correct on the input; T655's trigger-level data is mapped to input level (input correct iff all three triggers correct). Items with a 2-2 grader split are verdict 'uncertain' with no caught_by — the contested reference is reported, not resolved by guessing. Per-grader matrices and the disagreement band live in docs/infra/complementarity.md.
notes: Race C = discernment scoring (12 inputs pair-{1..6}-{minimal,orient}, two sealed null controls pair-6-*; T-D shape), five lanes findings/T62{0,1,2,3,4}-race-c.json, five independent grades findings/T65{4,5,6,7,8}-race-c-grade.json, attribution from the sealed key untracked/race-grading/race-c-grade/KEY.json. CONTROLS: pair-6-minimal and pair-6-orient are the sealed null controls; every grader's control check reports all five scorers matched the sealed key exactly, so they are non-discriminating union members (all five caught). CENSUS: T654 (provider-limit kill) was killed and salvaged — its grade is complete, present and scored. GRADER AGGREGATION: four of the five graders carry a per-item matrix (T654 matched-my-ruling, T657/T658 got-it-right, T655 trigger-granular mapped to inputs: input correct iff all three triggers correct, with the 7 unanimous inputs all-correct for every scorer); T656 has no per-item matrix (narrative only) and is excluded from the poll, stated. caught_by = majority >=3 of those four. The three items where the four graders split 2-2 (pair-1-minimal, pair-5-minimal, pair-5-orient) carry verdict 'uncertain' and NO caught_by: the reference ruling itself is contested, so they are excluded from every rate and reported separately rather than guessed. Grader cell agreement range: 67-92%. Sensitivity per grader: sensitivity-race-c-<T>.json. COSTS from untracked/tokens/tokens.jsonl, clean structured readings only (T621/T622 have one api-error zero-usage entry plus one clean reading; clean used, ambiguity flagged); deepseek scorers (T624, T623) have no structured usage, stated unknown. KEY sha256s hash the sealed originals, not the findings/ files (checked: they do not verify against findings/ paths); attribution taken from the KEY regardless.
